# konnect_event_gateway_produce_policy_mask_fields (Resource)

EventGatewayProducePolicyMaskFields Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_event_gateway_produce_policy_mask_fields" "my_eventgatewayproducepolicymaskfields" {
  condition = "record.value.content.foo.bar == \"a-value\""
  config = {
    failure_mode = "passthrough"
    mask_fields = [
      {
        paths = [
          {
            match = "someObject.someArray[1].fieldName"
          }
        ]
        strategy = {
          replace = {
            phrase = "...my_phrase..."
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
  description = ""
  enabled     = true
  gateway_id  = "9524ec7d-36d9-465d-a8c5-83a3c9390458"
  labels = {
    key = "value"
  }
  name               = "...my_name..."
  parent_policy_id   = "871e4106-2200-408a-9305-98647c57aee2"
  virtual_cluster_id = "7c87e642-a8c0-47b0-bf5f-35f8045c2887"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Attributes) The configuration of the mask record fields produce policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `gateway_id` (String) The UUID of your Gateway.
- `parent_policy_id` (String) The unique identifier of the parent schema validation policy. Requires replacement if changed.
- `virtual_cluster_id` (String) The ID of the Virtual Cluster.

### Optional

- `condition` (String) A string containing the boolean expression that determines whether the policy is applied.

When the policy is applied as a child policy of schema_validation, the expression can also reference
`record.value` fields.
Default: ""
- `description` (String) A human-readable description of the policy. Default: ""
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled. Default: true
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels store metadata of an entity that can be used for filtering an entity list or for searching across entity types. 

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong", "konnect", "mesh", "kic", or "_".
- `name` (String) A unique user-defined name of the policy.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the policy.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Required:

- `failure_mode` (String) Describes how to handle a failure in a policy applied to produced records.
* `reject` - rejects the record batch.
* `passthrough` - passes the record silently to the backend cluster even though policy execution failed.
* `mark` - passes the record to the backend cluster but marks it with a `kong/policy-failure-<id>` header whose value is the reason for the policy failure (truncated to 512 characters).

**Requires a minimum runtime version of `1.2`**.
possible known values include one of ["reject", "passthrough", "mark"]
- `mask_fields` (Attributes List) Selects which fields to mask and how to mask them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--mask_fields))

<a id="nestedatt--config--mask_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.mask_fields`

Required:

- `paths` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--mask_fields--paths))
- `strategy` (Attributes) The strategy used to redact a matched field value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--mask_fields--strategy))

<a id="nestedatt--config--mask_fields--paths"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.mask_fields.paths`

Required:

- `match` (String) A field selector. It can select nested fields and array entries.

Currently supported are exact matches.


<a id="nestedatt--config--mask_fields--strategy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.mask_fields.strategy`

Optional:

- `email` (Attributes) Masks an email address by applying a separate strategy to the local part and to the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--mask_fields--strategy--email))
- `keep_chars` (Attributes) Keeps a number of leading and/or trailing characters and replaces the middle with a fixed phrase.
If `first + last` is greater than or equal to the value length, the whole value is replaced with the phrase, so it never shows more characters than the original value. The phrase is fixed, so the masked output does not leak the value length. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--mask_fields--strategy--keep_chars))
- `replace` (Attributes) Replaces the whole value with a fixed phrase. The masked length does not reflect the original value length. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--mask_fields--strategy--replace))

<a id="nestedatt--config--mask_fields--strategy--email"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.mask_fields.strategy.email`

Required:

- `domain` (Attributes) The strategy used to redact the domain of an email address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--mask_fields--strategy--email--domain))
- `local_part` (Attributes) The strategy used to redact the local part of an email address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--mask_fields--strategy--email--local_part))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_event_gateway_produce_policy_mask_fields.my_konnect_event_gateway_produce_policy_mask_fields
  id = jsonencode({
    gateway_id         = "9524ec7d-36d9-465d-a8c5-83a3c9390458"
    id                 = "9524ec7d-36d9-465d-a8c5-83a3c9390458"
    virtual_cluster_id = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_event_gateway_produce_policy_mask_fields.my_konnect_event_gateway_produce_policy_mask_fields '{"gateway_id": "9524ec7d-36d9-465d-a8c5-83a3c9390458", "id": "9524ec7d-36d9-465d-a8c5-83a3c9390458", "virtual_cluster_id": "..."}'
```
